written_from: public log-format conventions of multi-tenant SaaS backup and restore services
public knowledge-base articles that quote log excerpts
public documentation for the cloud APIs such a service calls
provenance.note: This file is the sanitize-at-source artefact. It holds log line SKELETONS only: every value position is a typed placeholder, never a real value, and every component name is generic rather than any vendor's. Templates extracted from real bundles should be reviewed wherever those bundles legitimately live and then appended here in the same form. Nothing in this file needs to be treated as customer or vendor data.
